## Try It Out!
### Send Sharetribe booking confirmation with calendar invite via Gmail

Send booking confirmation emails with an attached .ics calendar file so customers and providers can add the booking directly to their calendar app (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, etc.).

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/transitioned` events.
* An IF node filters for accepted booking transitions.
* A Code node generates a standard iCalendar (.ics) file with booking dates, title, and description.
* Gmail sends the confirmation email with the .ics file attached.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Gmail account.
3. Update the IF node's transition name to match your booking acceptance transition.
4. Customize the Code node's event details (location, description, organizer).
5. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Gmail account
* A booking-type transaction process with accept transitions

### How to customize
* Add a Sharetribe Get User node to include customer/provider names in the calendar event.
* Modify the Code node to add location data from listing metadata.
* Send separate emails to customer and provider with different details.
* Add a Sharetribe Get Listing node for the listing title.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for transitions
Polls for `transaction/transitioned` events with the full resource including booking dates and listing info.

## 2. Filter for booking acceptance
Only continues when a booking transaction is accepted. Update the transition name for your process.

## 3. Generate .ics & send email
The Code node creates a standard iCalendar file format with booking dates. Gmail attaches it to the confirmation email. Recipients can open the .ics to add it to any calendar app.
